text: The purpose of this report is to provide the Board with a general status update on the three theatres (Sony Centre for the Performing Arts, St. Lawrence Centre for the Arts, Toronto Centre for the Arts).

The Board of Directors of Civic Theatres Toronto: 1. Received the report (January 22, 2018) from the President and Chief Executive Officer for information. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 remain confidential as it pertains to the security of the property of the municipality or local board.
